title: Swirling Alien Scarecrow
description: A tall green alien with glowing yellow eyes and a swirling vortex for a head stands in the center, its body formed from a wooden post adorned with colorful autumn leaves and flames. It is positioned in front of a decaying red wooden barn under a dramatic night sky filled with green cosmic swirls, falling leaves, and beams of light.
prompt: A surreal green alien entity with glowing yellow eyes and a swirling vortex of green energy for a head stands upright like a scarecrow made of old wood. Its torso is covered in vibrant autumn leaves in red, orange, yellow and purple, with small flames burning at its shoulders. It stands before a weathered red wooden barn at night, surrounded by glowing green spiral energy patterns in the sky and ground, falling leaves, and dramatic beams of light cutting through the cosmic atmosphere.
